whatIs.title: What is Odoo?
whatIs.description: Odoo is an integrated suite of business applications covering all operational needs: from customer relationship management (CRM) and accounting to sales, inventory, and billing. Modular and scalable, it allows organizations to start with essential apps and activate new modules as their business expands.

modules.title: Modular Coverage for Every Department
modules.subtitle: Activate only the business applications relevant to your current operational workflow:

items.name: CRM & Sales
items.desc: Lead tracking, pipeline management, online quotes, and legal electronic signatures.

items.name: Invoicing & Accounting
items.desc: Automated billing cycles, payment tracking, bank reconciliation, and dynamic financial reporting.

items.name: Inventory & Purchasing
items.desc: Real-time stock traceability, vendor purchase orders, and automated replenishment rules.

items.name: Project Management
items.desc: Task scheduling, team timesheets, milestone tracking, and project profitability analytics.

items.name: Human Resources
items.desc: Employee profiles, leave management, expense reports, and centralized recruitment.

items.name: Marketing Automation
items.desc: Email marketing campaigns, integrated web lead capture, and behavioral automation.

process.title: Our 8-Step Implementation Methodology

steps.title: Needs Assessment
steps.desc: In-depth diagnostic of your organizational requirements, current bottlenecks, and business objectives.

steps.title: Workflow Mapping
steps.desc: Mapping existing operational processes to align Odoo modules with your actual business reality.

steps.title: System Configuration
steps.desc: Setting up business rules, taxes, multi-currency, report templates, and role-based access permissions.

steps.title: Tailored Customization
steps.desc: Customizing views, specific fields, and custom workflows when necessary to match unique requirements.

steps.title: Data Migration
steps.desc: Data cleansing, formatting, and secure import of existing contacts, products, and transaction histories.

steps.title: Team Training
steps.desc: Role-specific hands-on training sessions to ensure quick onboarding and everyday user confidence.

steps.title: Deployment & Go-Live
steps.desc: Controlled system cutover with dedicated live support during the transition phase.

steps.title: Post-Go-Live Support
steps.desc: Ongoing maintenance, adjustments, and optimization guidance to maximize your long-term ROI.
